description: Phase 1 bug fixes across components and screens. Fix all broken buttons and interactions, replace Google Maps provider with Gebeta UrlTile maps, and fix the RestaurantDetails createAsyncThunk-inside-component crash. These are independent file-level fixes that must land first because all subsequent FEATs depend on a working, navigable app.
steps: 1. components/CategoryCard.js — Add onPress prop to the component signature. Call it inside the Pressable: <Pressable onPress={onPress} ...>. Default onPress to a no-op (() => {}) so existing usages without onPress don't crash.

2. components/Categories.js — Add a selectedCategory state (useState(null)). Attempt to fetch from Firestore 'categories' collection with getDocs on mount; fall back to the existing hardcoded array if the query fails or returns empty. Pass an onPress handler to each CategoryCard: onPress={() => setSelectedCategory(title)}. Accept an optional onCategorySelect prop and call it with the category title so Home.js can receive the selection. If no Firestore categories exist the hardcoded list is shown unchanged.

3. components/FeaturedRow.js — Wrap the ArrowRightIcon in a TouchableOpacity. The onPress should call navigation.navigate('Home') for now (a full list page does not exist yet; navigating home is the safe no-crash fallback). Import useNavigation from '@react-navigation/native'. Keep the existing restaurant load logic unchanged.
4. screens/OptionsScreen.js — Add onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} to the back-button Pressable (currently has a commented-out onPress). No other changes.

5. screens/ProfileScreen.js — (a) Add Platform to the existing react-native import. (b) Import Constants from 'expo-constants' (already in node_modules). (c) Replace the MapView provider='google' with MapView (no provider prop). Add a UrlTile child component with urlTemplate={'https://mapapi.gebeta.app/api/v1/route/tile/{z}/{x}/{y}/?apiKey=' + (Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.gebetaMapsApiKey || '')}. Import UrlTile from 'react-native-maps'. The Marker and all other MapView props stay the same.

6. screens/RestaurantDetails.js — (a) Remove the createAsyncThunk import and the setRestaurantAsync call inside useEffect. (b) In its place, write a plain async function fetchRestaurant() directly in useEffect: call getDoc(doc(db,'restaurants',restaurantUid)), if snap exists call setRestaurantInfo(items) and dispatch(setRestaurant({id,name,rating,address,description,image,lat,lng,minDeliveryTime,maxDeliveryTime})). (c) Fix onPress={navigation.goBack} → onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} on the back button TouchableOpacity. Remove the createAsyncThunk import entirely.

7. screens/Home.js — (a) Import Constants from 'expo-constants'. (b) In the Modal, replace <MapView provider='google' showsUserLocation /> with <MapView showsUserLocation><UrlTile urlTemplate={'https://mapapi.gebeta.app/api/v1/route/tile/{z}/{x}/{y}/?apiKey='+(Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.gebetaMapsApiKey||'')} /></MapView>. Import UrlTile from 'react-native-maps'. The modal open/close logic stays the same.

8. screens/UserDetails.js — (a) Import Constants from 'expo-constants'. (b) Replace the MapView provider='google' with MapView (no provider). Add UrlTile child with the same gebeta urlTemplate as above. Import UrlTile from 'react-native-maps'. All other props (showsUserLocation, initialRegion, Marker) stay the same.
acceptance_criteria: Tapping a CategoryCard no longer does nothing — onPress fires without crashing.
The back button in OptionsScreen navigates back.
RestaurantDetails loads without a 'createAsyncThunk cannot be called inside a reducer' or similar runtime error.
The back button arrow in RestaurantDetails navigates back (navigation.goBack() is called).
ProfileScreen, Home modal, and UserDetails all render MapView without requiring Google Maps API key (uses Gebeta UrlTile).
npx expo config --type introspect completes without Error or SyntaxError.
